## Artificial Intelligence in Social Sciences Research Lab (AISS)

I am the Scientific Director of [AISS](https://aiss.self.bocconi.platform.sparkfabrik.cloud/),
Bocconi University's lab for AI methods in social science research. The lab was
created under the university's 2026–2030 Strategic Plan and is open to
researchers from every Bocconi department and research centre.

AI is changing what social scientists can measure and study. Text, images, audio
and administrative records that once needed years of manual coding can now become
structured data, and questions that were out of reach become answerable. AISS
helps Bocconi researchers work at that frontier through two pillars:

- **Projects Incubator.** Support for research that AI makes possible, not just
  faster: computing resources, research assistance and methods advice for
  selected projects.
- **AI Clinic.** Open to every Bocconi researcher: help choosing the right method,
  tools and computing resources for a research question.

The lab is interdisciplinary by design, so methods developed in one field travel
to others. It is overseen by a Steering Committee and an International Advisory
Board.

[Visit the AISS website →](https://aiss.self.bocconi.platform.sparkfabrik.cloud/){.more-link}

## Bocconi AI and Society Conference

I organized the first Bocconi AI and Society Conference, held in June 2026.
